Hi Emily / Derek —

Great to meet you both on the discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical runthrough: 

Summary from our call:
- Primary goal: validate latency, cost, and integration pattern for low-latency recommendations (90–200 token responses).
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent PII handling, regional data residency (US only), and predictable 95th-pct latency under 200ms for 1–2k QPS bursts.

Proposed next step (what I suggest we book):
1) 60–90 minute technical runthrough with our ML infra + solutions engineering team to:
   - walk your infra and data flow,
   - review model variants and quantization tradeoffs,
   - validate caching / KV expectations and warm-up strategies,
   - run an ops checklist for deployment and monitoring.

2) Please share the following before the runthrough so we can prepare concrete examples:
   - small sample of the request schema (anonymized) or a one-page data sample,
   - top 3 success criteria for the POC (latency, cost, throughput, accuracy),
   - any internal compliance questions we should address up front.

Slots we have available (all in PDT):
- Wed Mar 24: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Mar 25: 09:00–10:30

Attendees I recommend from our side: Marissa Cole (SE) and Camila Reyes (CS). I attached a short one-pager that summarizes Redwood’s runthrough template.

If you confirm a preferred slot and any additional Aurelia attendees (e.g., infra lead), I’ll send a calendar invite and prep checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
